post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller’s full name, as they spelled it.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The best number to call the caller back on, if different from the number they called from.

post_call_analysis_data.name: email
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller’s email address, only if they gave one.

post_call_analysis_data.name: new_or_returning
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the caller is a new or returning client.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: What they wanted to book, using the business's appointment names: Free consultation, Anti-wrinkle treatment, Lip filler, HydraFacial, Laser hair removal, Lash lift and tint, Gel nails.

post_call_analysis_data.name: preferred_times
post_call_analysis_data.description: The days and times that suit them, in their words.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The main reason for the call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if a specific day and time was agreed on the call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked_for
post_call_analysis_data.description: If booked: the agreed date and time as ISO 8601 with the UK offset, for example 2026-11-14T10:00:00+00:00. Leave empty if no exact time was agreed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked_with
post_call_analysis_data.description: If booked: the first name of the team member the appointment is with, if one was agreed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent_concern
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller described any concern after a treatment from the safety list.

post_call_analysis_data.name: demo_lead
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked about getting this receptionist for their own business.
